## What changed?

Briefly describe the problem and your solution. Link the related issue if there
is one.

## How did you check it?

List the tests you ran and any manual checks that would help a reviewer. For
mesh-generation changes, include the grid size, before-and-after compact
quality metrics, and an image when the difference is visual.

## Anything else?

Call out compatibility concerns, known limitations, or follow-up work. Delete
this section if there is nothing else to add.

## Checklist

- [ ] Ruff check and format check pass
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Build and Twine checks pass
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated when needed
- [ ] Mesh changes include a regression test and compact quality comparison
- [ ] Generated files in this pull request are intentional and reasonably sized
- [ ] No credentials, proprietary data, or third-party airfoil collections are included
- [ ] Required third-party license and copyright notices are included

If an item does not apply, mark it complete and briefly explain why above.
